prompt: Create an original 60 second instrumental neo-soul instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: electric piano, electric bass, clean guitar, drums. Style: pocket groove with syncopated seventh chords. Tempo approximately 80 BPM; D major. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A smooth, melodic, and uplifting instrumental track featuring piano, strings, and light percussion.
description.zh: 一首流畅、旋律优美、令人振奋的纯音乐曲目，包含钢琴、弦乐和轻柔的打击乐。
